entity_findings.message: The agent said “B X 7 Q 2” instead of “D X 7 Q 2”.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks for calling Olive and Ember. I'm Ava, the Reservations Assistant. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi, I need to change an existing reservation.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Sure, I can help move your booking. What's the booking reference? It's the five character code in your confirmation.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks Priya. I found your booking, reference BX7Q2, a table for four on Friday at 8pm. What day and time would you like instead?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Actually it is D X 7 Q 2, and I want to move it to Saturday anytime between 7 and 9 pm.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Let me check Saturday. I have 7pm or 7, 30pm available. Which would you prefer?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I will take the 7 pm slot please.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Saturday at 7pm is available. Shall I move your table for 4 to then?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Done! Your table for 4 is now on Saturday at 7pm. Your reference is still bx7q2. Is there anything else I can help with?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: No that is all, thanks so much. Bye!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're all set. Thanks for calling all
